title: Nourishing Sweet American Redcurrants Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful American dish featuring redcurrants, perfect for a brunch mood, made with a papillote and FODMAP-friendly ingredients to ensure a delightful and nourishing meal. This dish is rich in fatty flavors and shattering textures.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the bacon into small pieces and cook in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the bacon from the skillet and set aside on a paper towel-lined plate.
In the same skillet, add the butter and let it melt over medium heat.
Add the redcurrants to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until they start to release their juice.
Create a papillote by placing a sheet of papillote paper on a flat surface and spooning the redcurrant mixture onto one half of the paper.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together, then pour the eggs over the redcurrant mixture.
Sprinkle the cooked bacon, salt, and black pepper over the eggs.
Fold the other half of the papillote paper over the filling to create a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Place the skillet over medium heat and cook the papillote for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until the eggs are cooked through and the papillote is golden brown.
Serve the Nourishing Sweet American Redcurrants Skillet hot, garnished with brown sugar if desired.
